Tools for the Amari Method.

These simple tools can support Living Practice and home movement work. You do not need to buy them before an in-person Assessment; the studio provides everything for the session.

Useful tools for home practice

Each tool creates a different kind of support, leverage, or movement option at home.

Pull-up bar

Creates a stable place for supported hanging and ring work when those movements are part of your home practice.

View recommended pull-up bars

High density foam roller

Provides a simple surface for supported positions and movement exploration. Firm density matters for the setups used in Living Practice.

View recommended foam rollers

Yoga block

Provides stable height and support for precise positions. Density and height matter for the setup.

Standard 4″ block, most practice members Compact 3″ block, under 5′5″ or very stiff

Gymnastic rings

Used with a pull-up bar for supported positions and active movement when those setups are part of your practice.

View recommended gymnastic rings
